hero.description: TrainMeet is the digital platform for model railway meets. Import timetables, assign stations and track every train in real time — right on your phone.

features.heading: Everything you need
features.subheading: A complete platform for managing timetables and train dispatching at model railway meets.
features.digitalTimetableDesc: Import timetables directly. All trains, stations and times — always up to date.
features.realtimeStatusDesc: Arrivals, departures and track changes update live for all dispatchers.

features.dashboardDesc: Overview with progress, timeline, train types and active movements.
features.quickHandlingDesc: Tap-to-advance: click to step arrival/departure status.
features.roleBasedDesc: Admin manages meets and timetables — users focus on dispatching.

tambox.title: Tambox
tambox.registerDesc: Register and manage your physical Tamboxes. Each box gets a unique identifier for authentication.
tambox.name: Name
tambox.identifierPlaceholder: MAC address, serial number or any text
tambox.identifierHelp: E.g. MAC address, serial number or another unique code identifying your physical box.
tambox.identifierDuplicate: This identifier is already used by another Tambox.
tambox.docsDesc: Download ready-made code to build a physical Tambox with Arduino (ESP32) or Raspberry Pi. Boxes authenticate via their identifier — no API key needed.
tambox.arduinoDesc: Complete sketch for ESP32 with WiFi, WebSocket, 16x2 LCD (I2C) and 4x4 keypad. Configuration-driven — the flow is downloaded at startup.
tambox.raspberryDesc: Python script for Raspberry Pi with LCD and keypad via GPIO. Same config-driven logic as the Arduino version.
tambox.apiDesc: All endpoints are reached via /functions/v1/tambox-api. Authentication is via device_code in the query parameter.
tambox.configFormatDesc: The Tambox downloads a JSON configuration at startup that defines the entire flow:
tambox.endpointTrains: Fetch trains with movement status for a station
tambox.endpointDepartureCheck: Check if sender has departed the train
tambox.endpointStation: Look up station by station code
tambox.configDesc: Edit the state machine configuration that Tamboxes download at startup.
tambox.adminOnly: Only administrators can edit the configuration.
tambox.assignDesc: Assign Tamboxes to stations in this meet.
tambox.noAssignments: No Tamboxes assigned to this meet.
tambox.manualDesc: Guide for configuring and using physical Tamboxes with TrainMeet.
tambox.manualS1P1: Go to the "My boxes" tab and click "New box". Give the box a name and an optional description. Enter your unique identifier (e.g. MAC address or serial number).
tambox.manualS1P2: Copy the identifier — it's needed to configure the hardware.
tambox.manualS2Intro: Download the correct code from the "Documentation" tab:
tambox.manualS2Arduino: Open the .ino file in Arduino IDE. Enter WiFi credentials and identifier in the configuration block.
tambox.manualS2Raspberry: Copy the .py file to your Pi. Edit the configuration block with WiFi and identifier.
tambox.manualS3P1: A station master assigns your Tambox to a specific station via the meet settings. The box fetches its configuration automatically at startup.
tambox.manualS4Idle: The display shows the clock and station code.
tambox.manualS4Dir: Press A-D to select neighbor station.
tambox.manualS4Receive: Incoming requests are shown automatically. Approve with # or deny with *.
tambox.manualS4Depart: Confirm departure with # when the block is ready.
tambox.manualS4Arrive: Confirm arrival with # to release the block.
tambox.manualS5Connect: Check WiFi credentials and that the identifier is correct.
tambox.manualS5Assign: Ask the station master to assign the box in the meet settings.
tambox.manualS5NotFound: The train number doesn't exist in the timetable for the current station.
tambox.manualS5NewId: Can be changed in "My boxes" if the old one is compromised.
tambox.configGuideDesc: Deep dive into how the Tambox state machine and configuration works.
tambox.manualS6P1: The Tambox is controlled by a state machine — a set of states the box can be in. Each state defines:
tambox.manualS6LCD: What is shown on row 1 and row 2 of the display.
tambox.manualS6Keys: Which buttons are active and what they do.
tambox.manualS6Auto: Conditions that make the box change state without a key press.
tambox.manualS6P2: The box always starts in the idle state. Each key press or automatic event can lead to a new state.
tambox.manualS6P3: The user types a train number → selects direction → confirms → the box waits for response → approved/denied.
tambox.manualS7Intro: LCD rows can contain variables that are replaced dynamically. Write them with curly braces:
tambox.manualS7ArrFrom: Station the train comes from at arrival
tambox.manualS8Intro: Each state has a keys object that maps buttons to actions. Each mapping has:
tambox.manualS8Action: What happens when the button is pressed.
tambox.manualS8Next: Which state the box transitions to after.
tambox.manualS8Param: (Optional) Extra parameter, e.g. index for direction selection.
tambox.manualS8ActAppend: Add a digit to the train number
tambox.manualS8ActClear: Clear input and go to next state
tambox.manualS8Example: pressing # sends the request and transitions to wait mode.
tambox.manualS9Intro: In addition to key mappings, states can have special settings:
tambox.manualS9AutoPoll: Polls the server automatically at regular intervals. Used in wait states.
tambox.manualS9Transitions: Automatic transitions triggered when the server responds to a request.
tambox.manualS9Flash: Shows the state for the specified number of milliseconds and then returns to idle automatically.
tambox.manualS9FlashExample: Used e.g. in the "denied" state to show DENIED for 3 seconds.
tambox.manualS10Intro: This is what the complete default flow looks like, from idle to finished line block:
tambox.manualS11Intro: Administrators can edit the configuration under the "Configuration" tab in the Tambox hub.
tambox.manualS11V1: Each state is shown as a card with LCD preview and key mappings.
tambox.manualS11V2: Click on a state to expand and edit LCD rows, buttons and special settings.
tambox.manualS11V3: Add new states with the "New state" button.
tambox.manualS11V4: Delete a state by clicking the trash icon.
tambox.manualS11J1: Switch to JSON mode for advanced editing of the entire configuration.
tambox.manualS11J2: The JSON structure follows the schema: states, texts, lcd_cols, lcd_rows, poll_interval_ms, version.
tambox.manualS11J3: Validate that the JSON is correct before saving.
tambox.manualS11Save: Click "Save" to publish the changes. All active Tamboxes fetch the new configuration at the next poll.
tambox.manualS11Reset: Click "Reset to default" to reload the factory configuration.
tambox.manualS11Tip1: Test changes on a single Tambox before rolling out to all.
tambox.manualS11Tip2: Check that all next values point to existing states.
tambox.manualS11Tip3: Variables that can't be resolved are shown as empty on the display.
tambox.helpLcdDesc: Shows status for neighbor stations. Each direction has a letter (A–D) and a station code. Arrow direction depends on position: left (A/C) shows < for out, right (B/D) shows > for out.
tambox.helpLcdTrainDir: Train out or in (arrow direction depends on side)
tambox.helpDoubleDesc: On double track, the display auto-toggles every 1.5 seconds between outgoing and incoming tracks. The arrow toggles between out and in direction, showing train numbers if there's an active block.
tambox.helpDoublePress: Press the direction button to interact with the block currently shown
tambox.helpDoubleNoBlock: If no block exists in either direction, a new block is created as usual
tambox.helpStep4: Single track: Wait for approval from neighbor station
tambox.helpStep5: Double track: Block is created directly
tambox.helpRespondDesc: When a request comes in, it's shown automatically:
tambox.helpArrivalDesc: Press the direction button for incoming block, then # to acknowledge arrival and release the block.
tambox.helpDeleteBlockDesc: Press the direction button for an outgoing block, then # to delete it manually.
tambox.helpCancelDesc: Press * at any time to cancel and return to idle.
tambox.stationDefaultsDesc: These TamBoxes follow the station to every meet.
